title: Manufacturing Engineer
teaser: Become part of our team as a Manufacturing Engineer, supporting and managing technical challenges for high-end telecommunication equipment manufacturing. Oversee production flows, process debugging, and quality metrics. Ideal for candidates with significant manufacturing experience and expertise in SMT and PCBA assembly.
description:
Meet the Team 

You will be part of a technically strong and independent team that will be the core for our India manufacturing operations.

Your Impact 

The Manufacturing Engineer (ME) will be responsible for supporting and managing the technical challenges with the Manufacturing partners (MPa) of high-end based telecommunication equipment.  

The ME will also be supporting the various business unit products that are manufactured out of the MPa and will be accountable for the following functions at the manufacturing site: Performs complex Manufacturing Engineering tasks using specialized domain knowledge and advanced business experience.  

Assists with the layout of production flows and lines, including plant capacity planning and management.  

Support identification of technologies required for new products Debugs process and product problems; collects data and analyse yield problems; drives corrective action.  

Manages suppliers; drives cost reduction programs; support the development of six sigma goals Communicates difficult concepts and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view Provides guidance, direction, and instruction to less-experienced team members and colleagues.  

Manages and drives Manufacturing Quality Metrics at the site for a set of products portfolio e.g. Yields, WIP Manages Quality excursions e.g. Line Stop, Purges Conduct manufacturing process and security audits, risk assessments, safety compliances  

Run the business budgeting for manufacturing site needs. 

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor's degree in engineering or science

8 years manufacturing experience or equivalent

SMT knowledge

PCBA assembly knowledge

Preferred Qualifications 

EMS experience

FMEA

MLT optimization experience

Conflict management

Independent  and self driven
